DO $$ DECLARE constraint_rec record; BEGIN -- Drop ALL foreign key constraints on created_by column FOR constraint_rec IN SELECT c.conname as constraint_name FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class t ON c.conrelid = t.oid JOIN pg_namespace n ON t.relnamespace = n.oid JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = t.oid AND a.attnum = ANY(c.conkey) WHERE t.relname = 'amp_indicator_layer' AND n.nspname = 'public' -- or your schema name AND a.attname = 'created_by' AND c.contype = 'f' LOOP RAISE NOTICE 'Dropping constraint: %', constraint_rec.constraint_name; EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE amp_indicator_layer DROP CONSTRAINT %I', constraint_rec.constraint_name); END LOOP;
-- Add the new constraint (only to dg_user) RAISE NOTICE 'Adding new foreign key constraint'; EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE amp_indicator_layer ADD CONSTRAINT fk_created_by_user FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES dg_user(id)'; END $$@;
